description: Potable water pipeline rupture underneath the sidewalk. Clean water gushing at high pressure for over 12 hours, washing away gravel and flooding road.

ai_analysis.summary: Pressurized water pipe fracture causing localized road surface flooding.
ai_analysis.reasoning: High-volume water loss with sub-base erosion risks under road surface.
